title: Decision: Acquiring TechStack Solutions Inc.
goals: expand product capabilities, acquire strategic IP, gain market share in enterprise segment, and accelerate growth through established customer base

options.title: Complete Acquisition
options.description: Full acquisition at $45M valuation with immediate integration of team, product, and customers

options.title: Partial Stake with Option
options.description: Purchase 30% stake at $15M with option to acquire remaining shares within 24 months

options.title: Strategic Partnership First
options.description: Begin with 12-month strategic partnership including co-marketing and product integration, with potential acquisition afterward

options.title: Decline Acquisition
options.description: Focus on organic growth and potential development of competing products/features internally

criteria.title: Valuation
criteria.description: Assessment of asking price versus market comparables, revenue multiples, and strategic value

criteria.title: Technology Fit
criteria.description: Compatibility of tech stack, architecture, and potential integration challenges

criteria.title: Cultural Alignment
criteria.description: Compatibility of company cultures, values, and working styles

criteria.title: Market Position
criteria.description: Current market share, brand strength, and competitive advantage in target segments

criteria.title: Financial Health
criteria.description: Revenue growth, profit margins, burn rate, and outstanding liabilities

criteria.title: Team Retention
criteria.description: Likelihood of retaining key personnel and integration costs for the broader team

criteria.title: Customer Base
criteria.description: Quality and stability of existing customer relationships and contracts

criteria.title: Regulatory Risk
criteria.description: Potential regulatory hurdles, compliance issues, and legal considerations

criteria.title: Integration Complexity
criteria.description: Estimated time, cost, and complexity of technical and operational integration
